conditions.compiled_execution: fastmath=False, serial compiled kernels, NUMBA_DISABLE_JIT=0, NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1
conditions.jit_isolation: each observation uses a fresh process and a unique initially empty NUMBA_CACHE_DIR

relaxation_problem.meaning: expanded C03 constant linear relaxation and additive force

identity.definition: stable manifest semantics plus final/events/series/frames/probes; timing and RSS excluded

interpretation.cold_warm_speedup: cold/warm is compilation-amortization evidence, not an inter-revision engine speedup claim
interpretation.rss: OS process high-water RSS includes Python and native libraries and is reported separately from the solver-owned memory plan
interpretation.scope: these focused workloads are not the P14 10k/100k/1M, field, event, output, and full product matrix
interpretation.thresholds: absolute seconds, RSS, and speedup have no pass/fail threshold

solver_memory_plan.semantics: predicted peak of solver-owned arrays; not process RSS
